name: Republic of Venice

flag.description: A red banner edged with gold ornament, bearing the golden winged Lion of Saint Mark with a paw on an open book, and a fly cut into six tails.
flag.symbolism: The winged lion is the symbol of Saint Mark the Evangelist, the city's patron saint; the book is traditionally inscribed "Pax tibi Marce, evangelista meus" (Peace to you, Mark, my evangelist).

hook: Venice flew a golden winged lion on red, its paw on an open book, with the fly split into six tails; no modern national flag looks anything like it.
trivia: The six tails are often said to represent the six sestieri, or districts, of the city of Venice.
The Republic ended in 1797, when the last doge, Ludovico Manin, abdicated as Napoleon's army approached.
